01 / Sample work

Ideas put into words.

These are fictional concept projects that demonstrate my writing approach. They are not paid client work.

PROJECT 01 / EMAIL

Morning Ritual

A welcome-email concept for a fictional coffee brand, built around the comfort of a good morning cup.

GoalGet the reader to explore the collection.

Subject: Make your morning as smooth as our coffee

From farm to your morning ritual.
If we have anything in common, we'll agree that there's nothing like a fresh cup of coffee each morning.
Unfortunately…
Busy schedules.
Tight calendars.
Heavy workloads.
Leave little time to find good roasted beans!
So, we at Morning Ritual decided to take care of that, so you don't have to.
We bring you fresh, high-quality coffee beans for everyday mornings or special occasions, suited to your unique taste preferences.
Whether you prefer bold or light roasts, we've got options for you.
Explore our collection and find your next favourite.

PROJECT 02 / SALES COPY

The Daily Planner

A sales-page concept for a fictional stationery product

GoalTurn a messy to-do list into a purchase.

Headline: Your day deserves a little more direction.

Waking up to a long to-do list isn't ideal. When that list is disorganized, it's even harder to know where to start.
You spend time switching between tasks, struggle to prioritize, and end the day wondering where your time went.
With our Daily Planner, you can bring more structure to your day.
Set your three daily priorities, organize your tasks, and take a moment to reflect at the end of the day.
Say goodbye to:
• Messy task lists
• Unclear priorities
• Losing track of your progress
Make a plan, focus on what matters, and give each day a clearer direction.
Designed to be comfortable to carry and available in three stylish colors.
Get Yours Today!

02 / What I do

Good copy starts with understanding.

My focus is on writing that sounds human, respects the reader, and gives people a clear reason to care.

01 / EMAIL

Email Copywriting

Welcome sequences, promotional emails, re-engagement campaigns, and follow-ups that give readers a clear reason to open, read, and act.

Welcome · Promotional · Re-engagement

02 / SALES

Sales Copywriting

Sales pages and product descriptions that explain value, answer common questions, and help potential customers make informed decisions.

Sales pages · Product descriptions

03 / LANDING PAGES

Landing Page Copy

Focused page copy that connects a visitor's needs to a clear offer, supports the key message, and guides them toward one next step.

Lead generation · Offer pages

04 / WEBSITE · SAMPLE COMING SOON

Website Copy

Clear, reader-focused copy for key website sections, including headlines, service descriptions, and calls to action.

Headlines · Service sections · CTAs

03 / Working style

Listen. Dig. Write. Polish.

No secret formula. I find out who's reading, dig up the real details, say one thing in plain words, then cut anything that doesn't earn its place.

Example: the Morning Ritual welcome email

Clear first. Clever only if it helps.

04 / About me

Still learning. Serious about improving.

I Wish To Be Better Than Yesterday

I'm Nafiz Khan, an aspiring independent copywriter from Bangladesh. I'm building my skills in Copywriting, with a focus on clear communication, careful research, and writing that respects the reader.

I'm at the beginning of this journey. The work displayed here consists of practice projects, and I'm looking for opportunities to learn, improve, and help businesses communicate more effectively.

Good writing should be easy to follow. That takes understanding the person reading it, finding what matters, and saying it clearly.

Be better, not perfect.
